faq_heading: Grandview condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Grandview. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Grandview, South Surrey and White Rock: 143 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 23 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 2 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Grandview fell from 164 in June to 143 in October (−12.8%), and 128 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 25.5% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 561 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Grandview?
Grandview also had 67 houses listed and 2 sold in October, against 143 condos and townhomes listed. The Grandview houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Grandview Heights covers about 1,050 hectares (2,600 acres) from 16 Avenue north to 28 Avenue, bounded by the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) on the east, under the Grandview Heights General Land Use Plan (GLUP) the City of Surrey endorsed in June 2005.

The strata stock sits inside named Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) areas — Morgan Heights (Area 1), Sunnyside Heights (Area 2), Darts Hill (Area 3), Redwood Heights (Area 4), Orchard Grove (Area 5a) and Grandview Heights Area 5 — each with its own land use and servicing rules.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The verified townhome stock is new-build strata in the NCP areas, and its anchor complex is The Loop at 2350 165 Street, a townhome community by Gramercy Developments arranged around a central park.

The Boroughs, by StreetSide Developments (Qualico), is the multi-phase townhome project in the 20 Avenue and 164 Street area, built in named phases — Holloway, Bexley and Chelsea — with a third phase started after an amenity building opened, per the developer's parent company.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Servicing is the rule that bites in Grandview: Grandview Heights Area 5 will rely on utility servicing through the adjacent North Grandview, Redwood Heights and Darts Hill NCP areas, which the City states are still in planning and have not begun construction.
Applications inside Area 5 can proceed at the same time as its NCP, but the City holds them at third reading until the servicing and financing stage is endorsed.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre at 16855 24 Avenue is the City's aquatic facility for the whole plan area, at the northeast quadrant of 24 Avenue and 168 Street.
Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Avenue stands directly beside the aquatic centre, so the 25 Avenue frontage carries school and pool traffic at the same hours.

Fergus Creek's habitat preservation area adjoins the Sunnyside Heights (Area 2) plan area south of 16 Avenue, and City plan material requires connections into it from 168 Street and the Pioneer Greenway.
Redwood Park, at 17900 20 Avenue on the area's eastern side, is a City-listed South Surrey heritage and nature park tied to the Redwood Heights plan name.

Area 5 drains two ways: northern slopes flow to the Nicomekl River via Burrows Ditch and Erickson Creek, and southern slopes to Sam Hill Creek and the Little Campbell River, per Corporate Report R144.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Grandview Heights Area 5 Neighbourhood Concept Plan, City of Surrey (plan process, not a building project): the last unplanned area under the 2005 GLUP. STATUS: Council authorized staff to initiate the NCP process on July 13, 2026, per Corporate Report R144, read 2026-11-03.

The Boroughs (Holloway, Bexley and Chelsea phases), 20 Avenue and 164 Street area, StreetSide Developments (Qualico): townhomes. STATUS: phase 3 started after the amenity building opened, per the developer's parent company, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: BC Property Transfer Tax (PTT) applies at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million and 3% above $2 million; a newly built Grandview townhouse may also carry 5% Goods and Services Tax (GST) that a resale does not, and the newly built home PTT exemption thresholds are stated on the Province's page.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Route 531 is Grandview's bus spine: White Rock Centre to Willowbrook via 152 Street and the full length of 24 Avenue, with stops at 160 Street, 164 Street and 168 Street serving the townhouse corridors and the aquatic centre.
There is no SkyTrain in South Surrey: route 531's endpoints, White Rock Centre and Willowbrook, are bus exchanges, and the 24 Avenue stops are the transfer points for both.

blocks.text: Grandview South Surrey Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with servicing status: in Darts Hill, Redwood Heights and Area 5, the City's own report ties development timing to servicing that had not begun construction in July 2026, so a presale's outside completion date matters more here than in built-out Morgan Heights.
Check creek setbacks on the Area 5 and Darts Hill edges: Erickson Creek, Burrows Ditch, Sam Hill Creek and Fergus Creek all carry riparian areas inside the plan boundaries.

blocks.text: Grandview home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

203 townhomes sold in Grandview with a median price of $829,900 (the middle half sold between $770,000 and $927,500), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $537 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $397 a month. 45 condos sold in Grandview with a median price of $565,000 (the middle half sold between $497,500 and $609,000), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $629 per square foot, a median year built of 2010 and a median strata fee of $439 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Grandview?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 143 condos and townhomes listed in Grandview. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Grandview a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Grandview had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Grandview from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 128 condos and townhomes sold in Grandview over those 5 months, out of 456 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Grandview sell for?
faq.a: 203 townhomes sold in Grandview between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $829,900.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Grandview?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
